name: Alpen-Chalets
beschreibung: The Alpen-Chalets is a holiday home in Tirol, Österreich. The accommodation is located in an area characterized by forest and mountain meadows. The building has several bedrooms and a living area. A fully equipped kitchen and a bathroom are available. The construction uses wood and stone as building materials. Various hiking routes are accessible from the accommodation. Places to stop for refreshments are located in the next valley. Guests manage their stay independently.
